name: codex-companion
description: Vornik async-offload companion for Codex. Delegate reviews, audits, validations, research, summarization, and project RAG memory work to a vornik daemon over MCP. 0.12.0: mirrors the claude-code 0.14.0 operator lifecycle triad — `configure-vornik` and `troubleshoot-vornik` join `report-problem`, carrying the same config-resolution hazards (fallback chain, silently skipped VORNIK_CONFIGS_DIR, cwd trap, restart-vs-reload) and the same symptom-routed diagnostic ladder. Copies are identical to the claude-code originals except that they address Codex. 0.13.0: mirrors the claude-code 0.15.0 `whoami` MCP tool — since Codex has no SessionStart hook announcing the detected repo scope (unlike Claude Code), the delegate skill now points Codex at `mcp__vornik__whoami` to check project_id / default_repo_scope / effective_repo_scope on demand, useful when the operator runs several Codex sessions a day against different projects/repos. 0.13.1: README's MCP tool list gained `whoami`. 0.13.0 wired the delegate skill's guidance but left the tool out of the advertised list — on the client that needs it most, since Codex has no SessionStart hook announcing the detected scope, which is the entire reason whoami exists. 0.14.0: mirrors the claude-code 0.16.0 `report_problem` MCP verb — the remote-daemon report path. Codex users hit this harder than most, since a Codex session is often not on the daemon host at all. Collects nothing host-side; nothing is submitted without the user. 0.15.0: mirrors the claude-code 0.17.0 `validate-install` skill — checking an install against the published reference architecture, read-only, on resolved state rather than configured state. Copies are identical to the claude-code originals except that they address Codex. Also mirrors `vornik-docs` (where the documentation lives, CLI --help before recall, and the site map). 0.15.1: mirrors the claude-code 0.17.1 VORNIK_API_URL trap in configure-vornik — the CLI's target daemon defaults to localhost:8080, i.e. production on a single-host box, and is a different variable from the VORNIK_URL that companion clients read. 0.16.0: mirrors the claude-code 0.18.0 backlog-deposit surface as a `backlog-deposit` SKILL (Codex has no slash commands), driving the same byte-identical `scripts/vornik-backlog-deposit.sh`. Capture an off-scope finding into the repository's own backlog with dedup + a secret scan, without derailing the current task. Client-side by design: the daemon must not write your checkout, and the daemon-side tool flattens an item to a single 600-character line. A parity test fails the build if the two copies of the script drift.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate async agent work from Codex to vornik.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the vornik companion MCP endpoint so Codex can queue long-running reviews, audits, validation, research, summarization, and RAG memory operations without doing all work inline. 0.9.0 adds a `knowledge` skill teaching Codex the daemon-owned knowledge-skill store: propose reusable procedures (draft → operator-approved → served to swarm roles + all clients), search/apply approved skills, and approve with an admin key. Distinct from SWARM-SKILL.md capability skills and from RAG memory. 0.10.0 adds a `report-problem` skill teaching Codex how to help a user file an anonymized Vornik problem report (bug, crash, or INSTALL failure) as a prefilled github.com/grinco/vornik issue via the deterministic `vornikctl report` CLI (with `--offline`/`--dry-run`), guarded by review-before-submit and zero-auth (the user files under their own GitHub identity; nothing auto-posted). 0.11.0 corrects the delegate skill's file guidance for the T-8f69 staging fix (2026-07-25): the daemon now derives skip_auto_extract from a workflow's require_input_artifacts, so Codex no longer needs to set it when attaching inputArtifacts to companion-architectural-review / companion-doc-review / companion-rag-ingest. The prior text scoped that advice to companion-rag-ingest alone, so an artifact-bearing review delegated from Codex was auto-extracted at upload time — which suppressed raw-file staging and left roles without the document_* MCP tools unable to read the attachment at all.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the vornik companion MCP tools when work is large, async-friendly, or should be preserved in project memory. Recall before delegating research or review work. ALWAYS pass repo_scope on every recall/remember/recent_memory/delegate/memory_correct call: resolve it once per session from `git config --get remote.origin.url`, normalized to a host/path token (strip trailing .git, scheme, and any leading user@; replace the first ':' with '/') — e.g. github.com/grinco/vornik. Derive it from the remote; never hand-guess or lowercase it. Omitting repo_scope makes deposits land NULL-scoped and pollutes other repos' recalls.
